item.title: Top 10 places in Hampshire among the best to live in England and Wales for 2026
item.description: Marchwood, Southampton and Winchester were among Hampshire's top 10 places to live for 2026 according to Garrington Property Finders.

item.title: Man charged with 23 shoplifting offences across New Forest
item.description: A Hythe man has been charged with 23 shoplifting offences by Hampshire police after target stores across the New Forest.

item.title: Flood warning for parts of Southampton
item.description: A flood warning has been issued for parts of Southampton with flooding expected over the next three days.

item.title: Council considering new tourist tax - including for cruise passengers
item.description: The ability to introduce a tourist tax in Southampton could provide “significant” income to invest in the city, a council meeting has heard.

item.title: Inside the medieval brewery with a rich history serving award-winning beers
item.description: A brewery inside the city’s only surviving medieval building, boasting a rich history and award-winning beers.

item.title: Award-winning developer unveils plan to transform derelict pub
item.description: Developers have unveiled plans to transform a derelict pub by converting the "dark and outdated" building into five flats

item.title: Judge's words as speeding driver avoids jail after killing woman in crash
item.description: A careless speeding driver who crashed into and killed a woman in Southampton walked free from court after sentencing.

item.title: Parents row with school over new scheme to 'earn' prom invite
item.description: Parents at Crestwood Community School have expressed their shock and outrage at a new school policy where students must earn points to attend prom.

item.title: Man who bit police and threatened to kill mum's partner walks free from court
item.description: A man has walked free from court after subjecting his family to a night of violence, threats and biting two police

item.title: Prolific shoplifter detained by police in Eastleigh town centre
item.description: Officers have detained a suspected prolific shoplifter after stolen meats were recovered from several stores in Eastleigh town centre.
